cohort: Two cohorts of high-risk pregnant women for adverse perinatal outcomes, with one from Pakistan (LMIC, 520 pregnancies) and another from Spain (HIC, 746 pregnancies).
finding: Different clinical and ultrasound descriptors are required for predicting low birth weight in different populations, with Doppler variables being most predictive in the LMIC setting and fetal biometry in the HIC setting, though Doppler data consistently improves prediction capabilities in both.
cross-section timing: Measurements taken from 28 weeks gestation until birth
